cardinality.rule: Events.VOI_MODIFIED: DISPLAY_SET_APPEARANCE_CHANGED fires once for every change of the appearance of a display set, also at its mount and when a scroll shows an image with another default window: test detail.cause and detail.changedKeys; the window is detail.effective.voiRange, the colormap detail.effective.colormap, what a caller set detail.overrides
